# Flight configuration: ais_img_3u / mtq_fmr

Owner: Agastya. Generated by `tools/pipeline.py` (node `dispatch`) from the converged design loop
(`matlab_sils/store/pipeline/ais_img_3u/selection.json`, status: **feasible**).
The MATLAB solution pipeline's package for this family is the parent folder.

- `sized/`: the converged sized parts and products (adcs-design), `sizing.json` with the demand and the knobs.
- `fsw/adcs_fswcfg.bin`: the adcs-fswcfg/1 blob the flight software boots from; `fsw/adcs_fswcfg.json` decodes it.
- `mission_scenario.json`: detumble at boot, sun_acq_rotor when detumble completes, nadir_fine by schedule at 2 orbits.
- Methods per mode: detumble = mtq, sun_acquisition = fmr, sun_referencing = fmr+mtq, nadir_pointing = fmr+mtq. Algorithms chosen by the loop: {"detumble": "bdot_gyro", "pointing": "pid"}.
- Units fitted: coils, rings, rings, rings, star_tracker, magnetometer, sun_sensors, gyro, gnss, earth_sensor.

Build: `make -C fsw` (C, libadcs_fsw.a) or `cd fsw-rs && cargo build --release --no-default-features --features cabi
--target thumbv7em-none-eabihf` (Rust, same ABI). C and Rust on the engine, same blob: bit-identical = True.
Soft OILS of this configuration: `results/DESIGN_ais_img_3u.md`. Real OILS: `adcs run mission_scenario.json --fsw tcp:<obc>:<port> --realtime`.
